# OLYMPUS v0.0.5, "Show clear": the build sheet

Written 2026-11-06 for the round's four implementers (arms, shot, stage, hud) and the lead who integrates: the contract between roles building in parallel without talking. Where it is silent the docs decide (DESIGN.md and the user's rules, then TECH §1.3 on implementation, then the sections); my own choices are marked (my call); every disagreement settled here is in §8.

**The release.** ROADMAP §4.2's 0.0.6 row, `test-handling` "Show clear", cut as v0.0.5 (CONTRACTS §18). **The user plays**: the 25 m line of Base Melas's KD range, alone on a lane, a generated coach at your shoulder and a generated range officer (RO) in the tower, the R-7 slung and three magazines of five in your pouches. G brings the rifle up and stops time; the tower's commands come (prone, LOAD, MAKE READY, commence fire); you fire five prone, five kneeling, five standing at a 25 m card, each shot a plaque, a roll in the log and a hole in the paper; in the second or third magazine the coach's set stoppage (drawn from the world's seed) clicks or jams, and you look, diagnose and clear it by its steps; CEASE FIRE, UNLOAD SHOW CLEAR, the coach looks into your chamber, "The line is clear." Scored on **the steps**, **the shot and its log**, **pace** (ROADMAP §2.2).

**What the user must feel.** "Detailed weapon handling": every action its time and its roll (routine ones marked, never skipped), the gun drawn and listed as the holder believes it, the stoppage felt, looked at and cleared by its steps, not a button. "Shooting should play as in Tradecraft": G is intent, time stands still while you choose, each step plays for its time, aim, the held aim, Fire, the double tap; the d20 against a DC with every modifier, the same list on the plaque and in the roll. Fun: one digit per Corps command with the singles under them, the tower's next command arriving by itself, the paper filling up, never a wall of text.

**The user's rules hold over every section**: places authored (the 25 m bay is part of `melas@1`, the same in every career), what happens in them procedural (your lane, the set stoppage, the tower's pace, the words: named streams and hashes); every person generated (the RO and the coach drawn for their posts); 16 px/m chibi; every picture and sound made by code; nothing pops, no fast travel, graphics over words, no overlapping UI, AZERTY labels on physical codes, every need runs through every gap.

**Rules of the round**: only your own files (§1), a change elsewhere goes in your issues written out exactly; no commits or releases; never `.play/`, :8200, :8201, the sibling projects (read freely; their pure modules only from a scratch script outside the repo) or `docs/research/`; heavy browser tests on your own `OLYMPUS_TEST_PORT`, servers killed; CPU ceilings × `machine().k`, printed; look at what you draw (`node tools/shot.mjs`, 16 px/m).

**Interfaces first.** Each role first writes §2's exports as stubs, then fills them; test against your own stub of a dependency until it is real, and say so. **Merge order**: shot (game.js, facts.js, the domain, checks), arms, stage, hud; `QUICK=1 node tests/run.mjs` after each. **A gunless game must not change by one byte**: the sandbox and a career's barracks (no rifle this round) keep every golden and digest (§8 item 9).

## 2. Interfaces

JavaScript signatures; `state` the saved state, `bus` the core bus, `pid` a person id, `gunId`, `magId` item ids, times integer game ms, positions metres in the area's frame (x east, z south, y up), angles radians (0 east, +π/2 south), `ms` defaults to `state.clock.ms`. Pure unless marked **w** (writes).

### 2.1 arms (WEAPONS §2 to §6)

**The gun** (`firearms.js`, ported from tradecraft `firearms.js`: `newGun`, `act`, `fire`, `feed`, `canDo`, `said`, `ready` keep their meaning; SKILLS' `paceOf` replaces `pace()`, grades replace raw margins, the belief is new):

```js
ACTIONS = { <id>: { s, dc, thumb, long, tempo: ['rushed'] | ['careful'] | [], frame } }        // §4's table
newGun(state, { model = 'r7', byId, cond = 0.93 }) → gunId              // w: Condition 4, bolt closed and cocked, safe, port closed, belief known
newMag(state, { fam = 'had30', n, load = 'ball', set = null, told = true }) → magId   // w; told: the belief knows n (the range detail filled it and said so)
actionMs(roller, gun, action, { tempo = 'normal' }) → ms     // s × (thumb ? paceOf(WH)² : paceOf(WH) × (long ? LONG_K : 1)) × TEMPO[tempo].timeK
canDo(state, pid, gunId) → [action]          // the singles the BELIEF allows, in panel order (below)
doAction(state, bus, { pid, gunId, action, tempo = 'normal', pressure = 'evaluated', observerId = null }) → result        // w
  // rolled on rngOf(state, 'main') through rollerOf; the truth changed at once (tradecraft's act()), the belief by §5.4, items by kit.move,
  // the roll logged { kind: 'roll', roll, step: action, gun }; result: { ms, ok, grade, routine, roll, mishap: null | 'dropMag' | 'discharge',
  // nd: null | ndOf(…), text, ejected: null | 'round' | 'dummy' | 'case', magId, halts }
act(rng, roller, gun, mag, action, ctx) → result   // the pure core; ctx { spares, pressure, tempo, light, observerId, pace (the parity test's override) }
pull(rng, gun, mag) → { fired, why: null | 'safety' | 'empty' | 'jammed' | 'dud' | 'broken', stoppage: null | 'case' | 'double', empty, set }   // w the two records
feel(belief, pullResult, { wh }) → belief          // what a pull tells its holder
misfireP(gun, mag) → p; jamP(gun, mag, { wh }) → p  // §4.3 whole: dust, foul, lube, heat read, nothing moves them this round
ready(gun) → bool; conditionOf(gun) → 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | null; conditionOfBelief(belief) → 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | '?'
beliefOf(state, gunId) → { model, short, chamber, mag, magFam, count, countApprox, mode, locked, port, stoppage, condWord, cocked }   // the only view the HUD reads
said(belief) → 'R-7: one in the chamber, about 3 in the magazine, on safe.'
REFUSALS = { safety: "The trigger won't move: it's on safe.", empty: 'Click.', dud: 'Click.', jammed: "The trigger's dead.", broken: 'Nothing: it wants the armourer.' }
```

**Action ids** (WEAPONS §5.2, the R-7's this round): `up` (slung to low ready), `stow` (to slung front; ends the mode), `posture:lowReady`, `posture:highReady`, `selector:safe`, `selector:semi` (`selector:auto` in the machine and its tests, never in the range's panel), `port`, `charge`, `release`, `lockBack`, `magOut:drop`, `magOut:dump`, `magOut:pouch`, `magIn`, `tap`, `pressCheck`, `magCheck`, `inspect` (bolt locked), `observe` (a look at the port: §8 item 14), `functionCheck`, `clearDouble`, `show` (the observer's look, in SHOW CLEAR only), `finger` (off: 0 ms, no roll). **`canDo` order** (tradecraft's, by the belief): slung, `up` only; a stoppage felt or seen, `observe`, `tap`, `charge`, then `clearDouble` once a double is seen; else `release` (locked, a magazine in believed to hold rounds), `charge`, `lockBack`, `magOut:dump`, `magOut:drop`, `magOut:pouch`, `magIn` (a spare in reach), `pressCheck` (first when the chamber is `?`), `magCheck`, `inspect`, `functionCheck` (believed empty, closed, on semi), the other of `selector:safe` and `selector:semi`, `port` (open), `posture:*`, `stow`.

**The set stoppage** (§8 item 6). A magazine may carry `set: { n, kind }`: when `feed()` takes the round at count `n` (tradecraft's `mag.dummy` rule) the chambered round carries `gun.set = kind` and the magazine's `set` goes. `pull()` then: `dud` (an orange dummy) clicks, chamber `dud`; `stovepipe` (a light-charged round) fires and short-strokes, chamber `case`; `double` (a round seated proud) fires and, rounds left, feeds two (`jam: 'double'`), else `case`. Otherwise §4.3's rates run on the shot's stream. Tap-rack clears `dud` and `case` (the dummy or case to the ground); on a double it changes nothing but its words ("It won't go into battery."); `clearDouble` clears it, the round it strips falling to the ground.

**The belief** (WEAPONS §4.2: only what the holder did, saw or felt): `charge`, `release`, `magIn` move it as the holder expects from what they believe; `pressCheck`, `inspect`, `magCheck`, `observe` copy the truth they look at; a `miss` on `charge`, `lockBack`, `magOut:*` or `inspect` sets that part `?`; a `bad` `inspect` sets the chamber `empty` whatever the truth (the one silent failure); the mode and whether a magazine is in are always known in hand; a pull fired counts down one (`countApprox` under Weapon handling 15), a click sets `stoppage: 'click'`, a dead trigger `'dead'`, a shot that did not cycle `'felt'`, the last round `locked`, `chamber: 'empty'`; `observe` turns `click`, `dead`, `felt` into what the port shows (`case`, `double`, `empty` locked back) or leaves `click` (the bolt home: a dud or nothing, which a press check tells).

**The macros** (`drills.js`, WEAPONS §5.3; each sub-step rolled and logged; a failure that is not routine halts, the rest into `stop.queue`):

```js
MACROS = { load: { label: 'LOAD', subs: ['selector:safe', 'magIn', 'port'] }, ready: { label: 'MAKE READY', subs: ['selector:safe', 'charge', 'pressCheck', 'port'] },
  unload: { label: 'UNLOAD', subs: ['selector:safe', 'magOut:pouch', 'lockBack', 'inspect', 'release', 'selector:safe', 'port'] },
  clear: { label: 'UNLOAD, SHOW CLEAR', observer: true, subs: ['selector:safe', 'magOut:pouch', 'lockBack', 'inspect', 'show', 'release', 'selector:semi', 'functionCheck', 'charge', 'selector:safe', 'port'] },
  'reload:speed': { label: 'RELOAD', subs: ['magOut:drop', 'magIn', 'release'] }, 'reload:retain': { label: 'RELOAD, keep the empty', subs: ['magOut:dump', 'magIn', 'release'] },
  'reload:tactical': { label: 'RELOAD', subs: ['magOut:pouch', 'magIn'] }, ia: { label: 'IMMEDIATE ACTION', subs: ['tap', 'charge', 'observe'] },
  remedial: { label: 'REMEDIAL ACTION', subs: ['clearDouble', 'observe'] }, cease: { label: 'CEASE FIRE', subs: ['finger', 'selector:safe'] } }
macrosFor(state, pid, gunId, { observerId }) → [{ id, label, subs, ms }]   // by the believed condition; clear only with an observer at hand; speed or keep from locked-empty, tactical with rounds left
subsOf(macroId, belief) → [action]       // skips only magOut:* with no magazine believed in and lockBack with the bolt believed locked; the selector's and the port's checks always run
macroMs(roller, gun, macroId, belief, tempo) → ms
```

`show`: the observer looks into the chamber held open toward them: `SHOW_LOOK_S` 1.0 × `paceOf(their Awareness)`, their Awareness against DC 6 (+4 dark), logged short (SKILLS §5.14). Passed and empty: "Clear."; passed with a round: "Hold. There's a round in it.", the macro halts; failed: "Clear." whatever the truth, and the function check fires what is there.

**Carry** (`carry.js`, WEAPONS §6; tradecraft `scenarios/range.js safety()` adapted):

```js
POSTURES = { slungBack, slungFront, lowReady, highReady, aimed }: { yawDeg, pitchDeg, hM, halfDeg, reachM, toAimS, habitDC, inHand }   // §4

muzzleOf(state, pid) → { x, y, z, yawRad, pitchRad, halfRad, reachM, posture, inHand }
inCone(cone, { x, z, spanM: [y0, y1] }) → bool                     // §6.1: a 0.25 m body in plan, the muzzle's line inside its span
habitStep(state, input, bus, ctx)    // w; fast 'rules': §6.3 against each person within reach + 0.5 m: one roll an approach, automatic when dc ≤ v + 1,

rangeSafety(state, pid, ms, line) → { warn: [{ rule, text }], stop: { rule, text } | null }   // line: { downrangeRad: 0, box, lane, hot, targetKey, people }; §4's rules
ndOf(state, pid, gunId, { during }) → { grade: 'ND-1' | 'ND-2' | 'ND-3', into: 'berm' | 'ground' | 'past', nearId, at: { x, z }, path }
  // §6.5's line spread by DISCHARGE_SPREAD × (1 − muzzleSafe(WH)); §6.6's grades; a line through a person is ND-3 and passes them (§8 item 19)
```

**Kit** (`kit.js`, TECH §6.7: one record per item in `state.items`, one holder each, `move` the only writer of a holder):

`carry` maps the postures to the art's rigs (`slungFront` front, new; `slungBack` slung; `lowReady` low; `highReady` high; `aimed` aim); `action` is shot's `stepNow` through `ACTION_FRAMES`; `flash` within `FLASH_MS` 70 of the last shot, `kick` within `KICK_MS` 140 (the art's constants), on game time, so stop motion freezes them.

### 2.2 shot (SKILLS §3 and §5; WEAPONS §7; COMBAT §3; the scene)

**Skills and the check** (`skills.js`, `templates.js`, `checks.js`: tradecraft's `skills.js` and `checks.js` ported with SKILLS's additions):

```js
SKILLS = { marksmanship: { name: 'Marksmanship', uses: ['eyes', 'arms', 'breath'], wf: 1 }, weapons: { name: 'Weapon handling', uses: ['hands', 'eyes'], wf: 1 },
           awareness: { uses: ['eyes', 'ears', 'head'], wf: 1 }, fitness: { uses: ['legs', 'torso', 'breath', 'arms'], wf: 0 }, …SKILLS §2.2's sixteen }
own(sheet, k) → min(23, base + bg); value(sheet, k) → round(own × (1 + wf × os / 100))      // no rust this round
paceOf(v) → max(0.45, 1.6 / (1 + v / 16.7))          // the ONE pace helper (SKILLS §5.12)
mitigated(base, v, fullAt = 24, keepK = 0.15) → v
TIERS = { private: { wf: [13, 17], base: { marksmanship: [8, 10], weapons: [8, 10], awareness: [5, 6], fitness: [10, 12], … } }, lcpl, cpl, sgt, ssgt, gysgt }   // SKILLS §11.1
RANK_TIER = { Pvt: 'private', PFC: 'private', LCpl: 'lcpl', Cpl: 'cpl', Sgt: 'sgt', SSgt: 'ssgt', GySgt: 'gysgt' }
rollSheet(seed, pid, tier) → { cls: 'soldier', os, skills: { k: [base, bg] } }      // stream('people', seed, pid, 'skills') (SKILLS §11.2)
sheetOf(state, pid) → person.skills ?? rollSheet(seed, pid, RANK_TIER[rank])         // a lazy sheet, nothing written
valueOf(state, pid, k) → number
DC = { easy: 10, average: 15, hard: 20, veryHard: 25, expert: 30, elite: 40 }; ROUTINE_AT 0
SRC_ORDER = ['task', 'env', 'gear', 'body', 'need', 'people', 'help', 'tempo', 'retry']       // a src 'body:thermal' sorts as body
TEMPO = { rushed: { timeK: 0.6, v: -3 }, normal: { timeK: 1, v: 0 }, careful: { timeK: 1.5, v: 2 }, steady: { timeK: 2, v: 3 } }
check(rng, { skill, value, dc, mods = [], tempo, pressure = 'none', procedure = false, hook, by, dcParts = null, verb = null }) → roll
  // one d20 (tradecraft's draw, bit for bit); mods sorted; the tempo's appended; routine when procedure, pressure 'none' | 'evaluated', not rushed,
  // and value + Σmods (tempo left out) ≥ dc + ROUTINE_AT. SKILLS §15.2's record plus dcParts and verb:
  // { kind: 'check', skill, value, roll, mods, total, nat, dc, dcParts, hook, tempo, steady, routine, pressure, ok, margin, grade, by, them, hidden, verb }
grade(margin, nat) → 'disaster' ≤ −10 | 'bad' −9 to −6 | 'miss' −5 to −1 or a natural 1 | 'pass' 0 to 3 | 'good' 4 to 9 | 'superb' ≥ 10
oddsOf(value, dc, mods) → clamp((21 − (dc − value − Σmods)) / 20, 0.05, 0.95)
opposed(rng, ours, theirs, { hook, them }) → roll; won(roll) → bool
checkText(roll) → 'Weapon handling check: 12 + 10 = 22 against 9: routine, done.';  checkShort(roll) → 'Weapon handling 22 against 9 · passed'
```

**The roller** (`combat/roll.js`; skills never import body, TECH correction 8):

```js
rollerOf(state, pid, { ms } = {}) → { pid, value: (skill) → n, mods: (skill, ctx) → [{ why, v, src }], light }
  // mods: bodyMods ++ needMods (src/sim/body/mods.js) on SKILLS[skill].uses, and 'no light to see it by' −2 in the dark
fixedRoller({ weapons: 10, marksmanship: 10, awareness: 14, fitness: 13 }, { mods = [] }) → roller          // the tests'
```

**The shot and the paper** (`shot.js`, `paper.js`: tradecraft `shooting.js`'s and `paper.js`'s formulas adapted; WEAPONS §7.2 to §7.11, §11.1):

```js
rangeDC(dM) → round(5 × log2(max(dM, 10) / 10)); opticMod(mag, dM) → v                // §7.2, §3.5
dcOf({ model, rangeM, part = 'torso', paper = null }) → { dc, parts: [{ why, v }] }   // 6 + baseDC + acc + rangeDC + PART_DC + targetDC: the card, 6 + 0 + 0 + 7 + 0 + 6 = 19
modsOf(state, pid, { gunId, target, part, tempo = 'normal', follow = 0, ms }) → [{ why, v, src }]
  // task: position (stand 0, kneel +2, prone +4), the aim held +round(min(4, heldS × (2 + MRK/10))) or 'still coming down' −2,
  // a follow-up −round(BURST_K × k × recoil × climbOf(MRK) × support); gear: the optic; tempo: rushed −3; body and need: the roller's
heldOf(state, pid, ms) → { heldS, v, toFullMs }
aimS({ pace, kindSight, opticSight, turnDeg, value, kindTurn, toAimS }) → s     // 0.6 pace kindSight opticSight + turn/((90 + 6 WH) kindTurn) + (turn > arc ? 0.4 pace : 0) + toAimS pace
fireMs({ recoil, pace, n = 1, rpm = 700, anchor = 1 }) → ms      // TRIGGER_S + (n − 1) 60/rpm + RECOVER_S recoil pace anchor (1 + 0.3 (n − 1))
tapsOf(mrk) → 1 | 2 | 3; climbOf(mrk) → clamp(1.4 − mrk / 25, 0.35, 1.4)
resolveShot(state, bus, { pid, gunId, target, part = 'torso', tempo, follow = 0 }) → { ms, shot }        // w
  // the pull on stream('shot', seed, pid, gunId, gun.rounds) (§7.11), Marksmanship never routine, the hole, the case (ejectCase), the issue's count,
  // the belief by feel(); logs the roll; emits 'shot' and 'fx' { kind: 'flash' }
plaqueOf(state, pid, { target, part }) → { part: 'PAPER', rangeM: 25, rangeText: '25 M', odds, oddsText: '85%', words: null, aimS, held, next: 'aim' | 'hold' | 'fire', dc, dcParts, mods }
  // dcOf and modsOf on the shooter's beliefs: a known distance in still air, so it equals the true odds
PAPERS = { card25: { word: 'the 25 m card', targetDC: 6, sizeCm: [30, 30], ringCm: 2.5 } }
KD_RINGS = [{ from: 13, score: 5, v: true }, { from: 9, score: 5 }, { from: 5, score: 4 }, { from: 1, score: 3 }, { from: -3, score: 2 }]   // below −3 a miss; nat 20 ≥ 2, nat 1 a miss
BANDS = { v: [0, 0.5], 5: [0.5, 1], 4: [1, 2], 3: [2, 3], 2: [3, 4] }          // ring widths
holeOf(paperId, roll, shotId) → { at: [xCm, yCm] | null, score, v, word }       // the place by hash('hole', shotId): never the dice
scoreOf(holes) → { shots, hits, score, of: 5 × shots, v, groupCm }
```

**Stop motion** (`shooting.js`, WEAPONS §15's glue on TIME §4.3's clock rules; tradecraft's `toggle`, `options`, `choose`, `tick`, `finish`, `readyGun` adapted):

```js
enterStop(state, bus, { pid, gunId, via: 'ready' | 'shoot' }) → { ok, why }   // w state.stop, holds 'stop'; the first step 'up' when slung
leaveStop(state, bus, why = 'player') → bool       // w; only in phase 'choose'; releases 'stop', deletes actor.headRad
liveStep(state, bus, { pid, step }) → { ok, why }  // w: V, A or W outside the mode: state.stop { mode: 'live' } for one step, no hold, null after
targetsOf(state, pid) → [{ key: 'paper:<lane>' | 'a<n>', kind: 'paper' | 'person', x, z, dM, lane, name }]
  // in the frame the camera shows bracketing each (AIM_LEAD_K, EDGE_KEEP_M, FRAME_HALF_M or state.$frame); papers left to right, then people
stepsOf(state, ms) → [{ id, kind: 'fire' | 'aim' | 'hold' | 'command' | 'single' | 'stance' | 'posture' | 'wait' | 'leave', label, ms, rushMs, carefulMs,
                        odds, routine, off: null | 'aim first' | 'on safe' | 'nothing in the chamber' | …, subs: [{ id, label, ms }], cmd, skill }]
  // TECH §2.6's options(): Fire, Aim, Hold, the commands (the tower's current first, cmd true), canDo's singles, stance, posture, Wait
chooseStep(state, bus, { step, tempo = 'normal', target = null, keep = false }, ctx) → { ok, why }    // w; the 'stop' action
stopInput(state, input, bus, ctx)   // w; fast 'input' (runs while held): out of the mode, a move key while kneeling or prone stands you (a live step)
stopRules(state, input, bus, ctx)   // w; fast 'rules' (a): the doing advances (below)
stepNow(state, pid, ms) → null | { step, i, action, k, fromMs, toMs, frame }
stopNow(state) → null | { mode, phase, pick, aim, held, doing, queue, reflex }     // the hud's view
```

**How a step runs.** `chooseStep` refuses in a skip, while a reflex card waits, or when the step is `off`; it rolls and applies the first sub-step at the clock, sets `stop.doing`, `phase: 'act'`, and releases `'stop'`. Sub-step boundaries fall at the cumulative formula times from `doing.fromMs`, each on the first tick at or after it, so a step lives `ceil(Σ ms / TICK_MS)` ticks (TIME §4.3). In the first tick at or past a boundary `stopRules` ends that sub-step (`step { phase: 'sub' }`), rolls and applies the next (a failure not routine halts: the rest into `stop.queue`, `step { phase: 'halt' }`), and with none left ends the step: one that completes the tower's current command runs on as a **chained wait** (until the tower's next command or `WAIT_MAX_MS` 15 s, cut at once by any step chosen; §8 item 16), else `phase: 'choose'` and `holdTime('stop')` in that tick, so the clock stands exactly at the step's end. **Interrupts** (COMBAT §3.3, this round's two): `orderToMe`, a tower command, ends a wait or a hold at once, and CEASE FIRE any other step at its sub-step's end; `gunStop`, a pull that clicks or a shot that did not cycle, ends the fire step and offers the reflex. **Tempo by the keys** (§8 item 15): a digit tapped `normal`, with Shift `rushed` (where rushable; never routine), held `careful` (where careful); Fire held is **hold and fire** (the hold to +4, then the pull, one step). **Taps**: Fire again during a fire step's recovery fires a follow-up at the same aim (`TAP_SPLIT_S` 0.25, tradecraft's `tap()`), a double from Marksmanship 8, a triple from 18. The mode ends by X in `choose`, `stow`, or the scene's end.

**The reflex** (`combat/reflex.js`, tradecraft's `reflex.js`; COMBAT §3.5 extended into stop motion, §8 item 8):

```js
KEEP_MS 120_000; NONE = { key: 'none', label: 'Nothing: let it come', step: null }
offerReflex(state, bus, { why: 'click' | 'stop', title, options: [{ key, label, step, ms }] }) → bool   // w stop.reflex, holds 'reflex'; a kept answer is chosen at once
chosenReflex(state, bus, key, { keep = false }) → option          // w; releases 'reflex'; keep → stop.keep[why] = { key, untilMs }; then chooseStep(option.step)
```

A click: title "Click.", options `ia` "Tap, rack" (`macro:ia`), `look` "Look at the port" (`observe`), `none`; a shot that did not cycle: `why: 'stop'`, "It didn't cycle.", the same. A kept answer still offered answers the next one without the card ("By reflex: tap, rack.", `reflex { phase: 'kept' }`). **COMBAT's steps** (`combat/steps.js`): `stanceMs(from, to, { gG = 0.38, fitness })` (§4 × `paceOf(Fitness)`), `STANCES`, `WAIT_MAX_MS` 15,000, `STEP_LONG_MS` 1,000; a stance step writes `actor.stance` (`'kneel' | 'prone'`, absent standing) at its end.

**The scene** (`scenarios/handling.js`, `people/staff.js`; `src/data/courses.js`, `src/data/people/posts.js`):

```js
HANDLING = { site: 'melas', area: 'melas.ground' }
testHandling(state, { at = null, setup = null })      // the fill; setup: null | 'hot' | 'bench' (tests and the bench)
startRange(state, bus, { course = 'fam25', lane, setup }) → session     // w armoury.range and ammoIssues; posts the first command
rangeNow(state, ms) → null | { course, lane, phase, string, cmd, hot, observerId, line, summary: { score, of, v, shots, faults, clearAtMs } }
onRangeCmd(state, ev, bus)     // w; the event 'range-cmd': the tower says it (say kind 'pa', the log), the phase moves, 'range' { phase: 'cmd' }
rangeSecond(state, input, bus) // w; fast 'second', live only: the RO watches; the line ready → the next command at a drawn gap; a nudge after nudgeMs lived
rangeRules(state, input, bus)  // w; fast 'rules' after stopRules and habitStep: rangeSafety's verdict → the coach's word, a fault, or the stop
drawStaff(state, postKey) → pid      // w; stream('staff', seed, site, post) (PEOPLE §3.13), tier 3, a sheet by its rank's tier, outfit 'rangeStaff'
setPost(state, pid, pose | null)     // w person.post = { key, area, x, z, y, face, posture, outfit }
COURSES.fam25 = { lanes: [1, 6], lane: { from: 2, to: 5 }, mags: [5, 5, 5], strings: ['prone', 'kneel', 'stand'],
  set: { mags: [2, 3], rounds: [2, 4], kinds: [['dud', 40], ['stovepipe', 35], ['double', 25]] }, roGapMs: [1500, 4000], nudgeMs: 30000 }
POSTS = { 'melas:kd-ro': { what: 'range officer', ranks: [['SSgt', 60], ['GySgt', 25], ['Sgt', 15]], mos: '0369', unitId: '2/4' },
          'melas:kd-coach': { what: 'marksmanship coach', ranks: [['Sgt', 60], ['Cpl', 40]], mos: '8531', unitId: '2/4' } }
```

**The fill**: `barracks(state, { at })` at 09:00, the player at their lane's firing point facing right; the lane `2 + int(r, 4)` on `stream(seed, 'range:lane', 'fam25')`; the player's sheet written by `rollSheet`; `materialise('range-fam')` with the set drawn on `stream(seed, 'arms:set', 'fam25')` (which of the 2nd and 3rd magazines, which of rounds 2 to 4, which kind by weight); the RO and the coach drawn and posted; `startRange`. `setup: 'hot'` starts at string 1 in Condition 1 at low ready, prone, the line hot, the mode entered and aimed at your card; `'bench'` the same with one magazine of 15 and no set.

**The tower's sequence** (the Corps' commands, WEAPONS §5.3; each `{ kind: 'range-cmd', prio: 2, src: 'arms:range', payload: { cmd } }` at the line's ready time plus a gap drawn from `roGapMs` on `stream(seed, 'range:gap', i)`; the RO reads what he can see: a stance, a magazine in, hands still, the rifle on safe):

| # | cmd | The tower says (≥ 2 phrasings by hash) | The line is ready when |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | `brief` | "Range is open. Familiarisation fire, two-five metres: three strings of five, prone, kneeling, standing. The line is cold." The coach: "I'm your coach. Wait for the tower." | at once (+3 s) |
| 1 | `prone` | "Shooters, assume the prone position." | prone, no step |
| 2 | `load` | "With a magazine of five rounds, LOAD." | a magazine in, no step |
| 3 | `ready` | "MAKE READY." | Condition 1 on safe |
| 4, 7, 10 | `fire` | "Ready on the right. Ready on the left. All ready on the firing line. Commence fire." (hot: the red flag) | locked back on an empty magazine, no step |
| 5, 8, 11 | `cease` | "CEASE FIRE." (cold) | on safe, the finger off |
| 6, 9 | `kneel`, `stand` | "Kneeling. RELOAD." / "Standing. RELOAD." | the stance, Condition 1 on safe |
| 12 | `clear` | "UNLOAD, SHOW CLEAR." | the coach's "Clear." on an empty chamber |
| 13 | `end` | "The line is clear." → `range { phase: 'clear' }`; the mode left, the rifle slung front | |

A command not done after `nudgeMs` of lived time is said again with the lane ("Lane four, LOAD."). **Range rules** (§4) warn (the coach's word, a fault) or stop: "Cease fire! Cease fire!", the coach takes the rifle, `range { phase: 'stopped', why }`, the end. **The coach** (`say` kind `speech`) speaks at the brief, after each string ("Four in the five. Breathe out, then press."), after the stoppage is cleared ("That was my dummy. Good.": what the set was, WEAPONS §11.3), at the show clear and at each fault, never doing your work.

**The instinct** (`instinct/range.js`, SKILLS §14, the DI's voice; ≥ 4 phrasings each; acts `stop:<step>` done by `chooseStep`): `range-cease` urgent (cold and off safe or the finger on: T CEASE FIRE), `range-muzzle` urgent (in hand, past 45° off downrange: T aims at your card), `range-stoppage` warn (felt: "Tap, rack." T IA; a double seen: "Double feed. Lock, strip, rack." T REMEDIAL), `range-cmd` warn (the tower's command not done: "The tower said LOAD." T it), `range-reload` note (locked empty mid-course: T RELOAD), `range-unknown` note (a `?` on the weapon card: T press check), `range-fire` note (hot and aimed: "Breathe out. Press." T hold and fire), `range-wait` calm ("Wait for the tower." T wait). While a session is open the base rules keep quiet below urgent and `situation` is null; in stop motion the line leads "Time stands still." and speaks every tone (§8 item 10).

### 2.4 hud (VIEWS §4.4, §7.4, §7.5, §8.3, §8.6, §8.10, §9.1, §10, §11)

**Keys** (`keys.js`, `input.js`): new `carry` KeyV (V), `stanceUp` KeyQ (A), `stanceDown` KeyZ (W), kind `sim` (queued `carry`, `stance:up`, `stance:down`); digits keep `('digit:N', 'digit')` on key-down (menus) and add `('digit:N', 'tap')` on key-up under `TAP_MS` and `('digit:N', 'held')` at `TAP_MS`. In stop motion `accept()` refuses the bare `digit:N`; the hud sends `{ act: 'stop', args: { step, tempo, target } }` from the panel it showed (tap normal, Shift rushed, held careful); Enter aims at the bracketed target; Q and D (KeyA, KeyD) step the brackets (`step: 'pick:-1' | 'pick:+1'`, no time); the mouse brackets on hover (`view.worldAt`), aims on a click, fires on a click on the aimed one; X sends `shoot`; in a reflex card digits answer and R toggles keep (`step: 'reflex:<key>', keep`).

**Rectangles** (`layout.js`, VIEWS §7.5): the state `weapon` uses `TOASTS`, `WATCH`, `PAPER` (new: 200 × 200 top centre, §8 item 21), `INSTINCT` with `STEPS` (720 × 148) on it and `RADIO` on `STEPS`, `KEYS`; a reflex card takes `STEPS`' place; apart at 1024 × 768, 1280 × 600, 1600 × 900, 1920 × 1080.

**The step panel** (`hud/steps.js`): the weapon card (180 × 148, `paintWeaponCard(beliefOf)`) at its left, `stepsOf()` in two columns of five: 1 Fire, 2 Aim, then the commands (the tower's current marked), the singles; past nine, 0 is "more" and pages the singles; "3 LOAD · 2.4 s", a macro's sub-steps as glyph ticks filling as they run (✓ pass, ◦ routine, ✗ fumbled), `off` struck through with its reason ("1 fire · 0.4 s (on safe)"), "routine" for a percentage, the Shift and held times on hover. **The plaque** (`src/ui/plaque.js`): over the bracketed card, "PAPER · 25 M · 85% · AIM 0.9 S" or "… · +4 IN 1.3 S · CLICK FIRE", hover listing the DC's parts and every modifier as believed. **`PAPER`**: your card from `rangeLook()` at `PAPER_K` 4 px a cm, holes numbered in the string, the newest ringed, the string's score at its cease fire. **The radio box**: `say` facts, `pa` as "◉ TOWER · SSGT <NAME>", `speech` as "◉ SGT <NAME> · BESIDE YOU", two lines, 3.5 s + 0.33 s a word (tradecraft's earpiece cadence). **The log** (`cards/log.js`): every roll a `checkShort` line folding open to `checkText` with `dcParts`; toasts carry only shots, failures not routine, faults. **The reflex card** (`hud/reflex.js`, VIEWS §8.10). **I** (`cards/inventory.js`): `kitView()`, believed counts only. **The scene** (`cards/tests.js`, `end.js`): `endsScene` takes a list of phases; the end card shows `rangeNow().summary` ("Clear at 09:14 · 61 of 70 · 4 V · no faults"); **Copy my scores** gives `OLYMPUS v0.0.5 · test-handling · seed 48213 · steps 85 · shot 70 · pace 60 · ★ no · note: …`.

**Sound by code** (`audio/range.js`, `sounds.js`; inputs: facts and `rangeLook` only): the R-7's report at the shooter (`shot`: the muzzle 0.9 m ahead; `airDb(65.9)` −1.9 dB), the berm's slap-back 0.17 s later (2 × 28 m at 322 m/s) at −12 dB, ear defenders (`kitLook.ears`) taking impulses down `EARS_DB` −25 dB with a 2 kHz low-pass (speech stays text); the action's clicks on each `step { phase: 'sub' }` at its fraction (`ACTION_SOUNDS`: the magazine's seat at 0.8 of `magIn`, the charging handle's pull at 0.35 and slam at 0.9, the release's slam at 0.5, the tap's palm at 0.5, the selector at 0.6, the dry click of a `dud` or `empty` pull); a case's tick on regolith at its `landMs` as the clock passes it (nothing new while time stands still); the PA's chime before each `pa` line. **`main.js` and the handle**: `?play=test-handling&seed=48213[&hour][&setup=hot|bench]`; the keys card adds G, X, the digits (tap, Shift, held), A and W, V, Enter, Q and D; `debug.js` adds `gun()` (truth and belief), `steps()`, `plaque()`, `range()`, `stop()`.

### 2.6 game.js and the shared files, exactly (the shot role)

- `src/sim/game.js`: imports `weaponsDomain`; `STUB_DOMAINS` loses `weapons`, `BUILT_IN` gains it; `SCENARIOS` and `SCENARIO_SITES` add `'test-handling'` (`melas`); `newGame` takes `setup = null` and calls `fill(s, { at, setup })`.
- **The weapons domain** (`arms/domain.js`): `{ name: 'weapons', owner: 'WEAPONS', keys: ['stop', 'items', 'armoury'], init: fillDomain each key exactly as the stub did, idMaps: { items: 'i', 'armoury.guns': 'i' }, idFields: { 'people{}.kit.worn{}': 'i', 'people{}.kit.hands[]': 'i', 'items{}.mag': 'i', 'items{}.holds[]': 'i', 'stop.gun': 'i' }, fast: { input: stopInput, rules: one contributor running stopRules, habitStep, rangeRules in that order, second: rangeSecond }, events: { 'range-cmd': onRangeCmd }, actions: { ready, digit, shoot, stop, carry, stance }, upgrades: [] }`. `ready` (G): with a gun on the player, `enterStop`; **with none, v0.0.4's stub unchanged** (hold `'ready'`, the line "Weapon ready: time stands still until you choose (a digit)."); `digit` releases `'ready'` and nothing else; `shoot` (X) enters or leaves; `stop` is `chooseStep` (with `reflex:` answers and picks); `carry` and `stance`: a step in the mode, a live step out of it.
- `src/sim/time/domain.js`: `ready` and `digit` leave its actions and its header. `src/sim/time/doing.js`: `feetHeld` also while `state.stop` is set or the player's actor has a `stance`. `src/sim/people/place.js`: `placed()` adds the people posted on the live area, `whereIs` returns a posted person's post pose. `src/sim/people/roster.js`: `drawCore(seed, unitId, def, tier, r = stream('roster', seed, unitId, def.key))` and an exported `admitStaff(state, core, def, postKey)` (made, named and registered, no billet); the roster's own draws unchanged.
- `src/sim/skills/instinct.js`: `RANGE_RULES` merged by tone after `BASE_RULES`; `settle(…, { urgentOnly: isHeld(state) && !isHeld(state, 'stop') })`. `instinct/base.js`: while `rangeNow(state)`, the needs only at urgent and `situation` null; `doAct` routes `stop:*` to `chooseStep`.
- `src/data/scenes.js`: `'test-handling': { id, title: 'Show clear', scenario: 'test-handling', hour: 9.0, goal: "The 25 m line, on the tower's commands: make ready, fire your string, clear the stoppage, unload and show clear.", aspects: [['steps', 'every action its time and its roll; the stoppage by its steps'], ['shot', 'the plaque, the roll in the log, the hole in the paper'], ['pace', 'quick to drive by keys, never a wall of text']], body: {}, outfit: 'utilities', course: 'fam25', endOn: { fact: 'range', phase: ['clear', 'stopped'] } }`.
- `tests/game.mjs`: `createGame({ …, setup })`. `tests/bots/lib.mjs`: `stepAct(step, tempo, target)` → `{ act: 'stop', args }`, `waitStill()`.

- **A gun** (WEAPONS §4.1, this round's fields): `{ type: 'gun', model, mag, chamber: 'live' | 'dud' | 'case' | null, jam: null | 'double', locked, mode, cocked, portOpen, set, cond, foul, dust, lube, barrelC, rounds, byId, belief }`, saved without its defaults (TECH §6.6: `foul` and `dust` 0, `lube` 'wet', `barrelC` the air's, `jam` null, `locked` false, `set` null). `belief = { chamber: 'live' | 'empty' | '?' | 'dud' | 'case', mag: 'in' | 'out', count, countApprox, mode, locked, port, stoppage: null | 'click' | 'dead' | 'felt' | 'case' | 'double', condWord }` (WEAPONS §4.2's `safe` is `mode === 'safe'`). A magazine `{ type: 'mag', fam, n, load, cond, dust, set?, belief?: { n, approx } }` (no `belief`: unknown, the card shows its baseplate).
- **The kit** (TECH §6.7): `person.kit = { tmpl, worn: { carrier, head, sling }, hands: [right, left], carry: { posture, finger: 'off' | 'on', near: { <pid>: { atMs, result } } } }`: the rifle stays `worn.sling` whatever its posture (in hand is a posture, not a holder); a magazine's holder is its pouch, a gun's `mag` or the ground (`places.sites.melas.items: [{ id, area, x, z }]`).
- **`state.stop`** (TECH §6.1's key): `{ mode: 'stop' | 'live', who, gun, phase: 'choose' | 'act', pick, aim: { key, settledMs } | null, doing: { step, tempo, subs, i, fromMs, untilMs, cmd, chain } | null, queue, reflex, keep: { <why>: { key, untilMs } } }`, null outside; holds `'stop'` while choosing, `'reflex'` while a card waits.
- **New fields**: actors' `stance` (`'kneel' | 'prone'`), `headRad` (the mode only); people's `skills` (SKILLS §15.1: written for the scene's player only, lazy for everyone else), `kit` (the player in the scene), `post` and `tier: 3` (staff). **`armoury.range`**: the session (the course, the lane and its spot, the staff, the issue, the set, the phase and string, the command, ≤ 100 shots with their holes, ≤ `BRASS_LIVE` 64 brass, faults, the warned clock per rule, the end `{ phase, atMs, why }`). Data keys never sit in `*Id` fields (CONTRACTS §10): `course`, `lane`, `set`; `post.key`, not `id` (the ids walk reads every `id` field as a definition).
- **upgradeState for a v0.0.4 save: none.** Every addition is optional and the weapons domain fills its keys exactly as v0.0.4's stub did, so a v0.0.4 save loads unchanged and a gunless game saves byte for byte as before. Two v0.0.4 saves are added as proof (made with v0.0.4's own code in a scratch worktree of the tag, removed after): `tests/saves/v0.0.4-barracks-1300.json.gz` (a career's afternoon) and `v0.0.4-barracks-ready.json.gz` (saved while G's `'ready'` holds time).

## 5. Tests

Names are sentences in the files; here the suite, what it **prints** and what it **holds**. Numbers six spaces in; assertions carry their evidence; CPU ceilings × `machine().k`, printed. **Tradecraft's parity numbers below come from a scratch run of its own modules and are pasted in**: no test imports `../tradecraft` (the repository is public and cloned alone on Windows).

### 5.1 arms

- **`firearms`** (quick). **Prints** WEAPONS §5.2's manipulation table at WH 3, 7, 10, 15, 20, 30 beside WEAPONS's; every action from every state of the R-7 (before, action, truth after, belief after); each refusal's words; the set's three kinds and their clearing. **Holds** (a) Condition 4 to 1 by the singles; the bolt locks on the last round; `safeNeedsCocked`; tap-rack clears a dud and a stovepipe, changes nothing on a double but its words, `clearDouble` clears it; (b) **truth against belief**: a `bad` inspect leaves the belief `empty` with a round in, a `miss` lock back leaves `?`, nothing but a look or a check copies the truth, `beliefOf` returns no truth field; (c) **tradecraft's fumble ladder, exactly**: its own experiment (`stream('fa', 3)`, a Makarov drawn from the belt at 1.0 s and DC 8, 400 draws each at values 1, 7, 21, 31, then a chambered Glock holstered 400 times at value 1) through `act()` with tradecraft's `pace` injected and pressure `danger` gives **1.847, 1.394, 0.923, 0.590 s mean; 119, 13, 17, 27 fumbled; 15, 6, 0, 0 dropped; 12 discharges**.
- **`firearms-rates`** (heavy). **Prints** WEAPONS §4.3's states over 200,000 pulls each beside the closed form, stoppages per 1,000 rounds, and tradecraft's own at its conditions (cond 0.95: 0.60% duds of pulls, 0.26% stoppages of shots; 0.6: 2.97%, 3.49%; 0.35: 4.93%, 10.08%). **Holds** fresh 0.015% and 0.06% ±30%; the dust storm's 1.2% ±0.2; worn 0.6 2.3% and 2.6% ±0.3.
- **`drills`** (quick). **Prints** each macro's sub-steps and time by tier against WEAPONS §5.3; the belief and `conditionOf` after each sub-step; where a rushed UNLOAD at WH 4 halts over 400 runs. **Holds** no macro past a failure that is not routine, its rest queued; a routine natural 1 costs ×1.6 time and halts nothing; `subsOf` skips only a magazine already out and a bolt already locked; SHOW CLEAR with a round left in (a forced `bad` inspect): the coach at Awareness 14 says "Hold.", a forced failed look lets the function check fire it: ND-1, into the berm.
- **`carry`** (quick). **Prints** each posture's cone by stance; §6.3's per-approach table at WH 4, 10, 18 over 2,000 approaches; the range rules' verdicts over headings 0°, 45°, 61°, 90°, 101°, 180° × postures × hot and cold. **Holds** a slung rifle never checked; one roll an approach while the coach stands 3 minutes in the cone; no habit roll decided by a natural; each rule of §4 warns or stops as it says, a warning again no sooner than 20 s.
- **`nd`** (heavy). **Prints** §5.4's grid (per 10,000 UNLOAD SHOW CLEAR cycles by tier × rested or exhausted, dark and cold × observer × re-checks) and the grades by the muzzle's line on the bay. **Holds** §5.4's figures ±20%; downrange and the ground ahead ND-1, uprange or the coach's span ND-3, never ND-4.

Each (my call) unless a source is named; the lead carries them into DESIGN.md's log and the sections.

32. **The cross-role asks applied as written**: shot.js logs a refused pull by `REFUSALS` (arms: 'open' and 'dead' gain words); `BRASS_LIVE` lives in `look.js` alone; `doAction`'s ejects are stored as the session's brass (`handling.js recordEjects`, a hand's throw for a round or the dummy); the weapons domain walks `places.sites{}.items[].id` as item references; `kitView` gives each pouch `holds` and `reachS` (a chest pouch 1.4 s, VIEWS §8.3's "from the chest, 1.4 s"; the dump pouch 2.0 s); `rangeLook`'s holes carry `string` and `atMs`; entering stop motion emits no `line` fact (the instinct's lead says it). Already done by the shot role and checked: the bench setup off safe, `fp` for the dangling `spotId`, range safety fed this tick's facts (the walk rule warns at once and stops after 8 s; the finger rule warns on a stance change).
33. **UNLOAD, SHOW CLEAR is offered only once the tower's current command is `clear`** (`stepsOf` passes the observer then only): the arms and shot roles both reported it in the panel from the first second.
34. **The selector leads the singles in `stepsOf`**: canDo's order (tradecraft's) put Off safe on the panel's second or third page behind the magazine's five at every commence fire. canDo itself is unchanged.
35. **The plaque names Fire's struck reason in CLICK FIRE's place** (`rec.fireOff`, given by main.js from the panel's Fire row): "+4 IN 1.4 S · ON SAFE", "· CHAMBER EMPTY", "· A STOPPAGE". The reason "nothing in the chamber" became "chamber empty" to fit the row. The plaque is kept 2 px inside the picture (main.js aimHud), its notch a little off a card at the frame's edge rather than its words cut off.

38. **The coach's string lines count the shots fired** (`COACH.string` by misses, `{Hits}` and `{shots}` in words): a string the set stoppage cut to four is "Four of four on the paper.", never "five".
39. **A shot that did not cycle throws no case** (`resolveShot`: `f.stoppage` keeps it in the gun); the step that clears it throws it, so it is drawn once.
40. **The observer speaks at the look's end**: `doAction({ deferSay })` returns the word, `shooting.js` says it as the 'show' sub-step ends (`firearms.js sayObserved`, the 'say' fact and its log line).
41. **J names the action before a handling roll** (`log.js rollLine`: "Magazine in: Weapon handling 25 against 9 · routine"), and the failure's toast with it.

## 10. The fixer's resolutions after the four reviews

Written 2026-11-06 by the fixer, after the code, runtime, design and parity reviews of the joined round; each fix is pinned in `tests/range-review.test.mjs` (or the suite named), failing without it. Numbered on from §9.

45. **A look that finds a round changes the rest of the drill** (`shooting.js queueAfter`): after the inspection sees a round, or the coach's "Hold.", "Carry on" is the lock back and the inspection again (and the show again, for the show) before the rest; a missed inspection looks again. `runSub` stops a function check with a round believed in. `subsOf` skips a lock back only on a bolt believed locked on an empty or unsure chamber, and `canDo` offers one on a locked bolt with a round seen.
46. **The set stoppage is cleared once the gun holds no jam, no case and no dud** (`handling.js afterStep`), not only on a round chambered: a double on a magazine's 4th round leaves the bolt locked on the empty magazine. Seeds 91 (the 2nd magazine) and 15 (the 3rd) pin it in scene-handling.
47. **REMEDIAL ACTION is its steps**: `lockBack`, `magOut:strip` (0.85 s, DC 6, the magazine into the free hand), `rack` ×3 (0.45 s, DC 5: `charge`'s code), `magIn`, `charge`, `observe`; 6.05 s at Weapon handling 10, as before (WEAPONS §5.3's 5.75 and the look). `lockBack` keeps a double believed ('double'); `charge` or `rack` with no magazine clears the jam and throws the loose round; `sparesOf` lists a magazine in the hand first. `clearDouble` stays a single, on the later pages.
48. **The hammer and the lever** (`drills.js subsOf`, `firearms.js act`, `shooting.js stepsOf`): with the hammer believed down on a model whose lever needs it cocked, a macro's first safe comes after its first cocking step, or a charge goes before it; the panel strikes Safe "hammer down: charge first" and puts Charge first; the refusal comes before the roll. My call on CEASE FIRE: it charges, which chambers a round from a magazine, as a marine with that lever must.
49. **The panel's offers**: Charge by tradecraft's rule (§2.1's canDo order kept otherwise); the ◉ from `courses.js MACRO_MARK` (MACRO_CMD less UNLOAD, which still answers 'clear' for the 'ahead' warning); the held aim reset only by `shooting.js HANDS_OFF` (tradecraft's list); a tap refused on a bolt believed locked, an empty chamber or a stoppage; `feel()` reads 'open' as the bolt seen back, no stoppage; Sling it leaves the mode.
50. **On the line, the line's own**: `hand.js handOffer` is null while a range session exists; `move.js lineStrafe` keeps the facing while a range session is open and the rifle is in the hands (the keys strafe); `handling.js rangeRules` counts a move key as moving only when `feetHeld` is false. My calls: one strafe rule for every stance (prone and kneeling stand you first, as before), and the coach at one spot for every stance, `range.js` lane coach (fp.x − 0.9, fp.z − 1.4), north of you and drawn behind you, rather than a spot by stance he would have to walk between (KD_RANGE's golden moved: 012fb0731f2139 to 09bbbab6c91cad).
51. **What J and the toasts say**: a roll's entry carries the action's words (`text`), hidden when the failure is silent; `log.js` leaves hidden records out (`hiddenRec`; debug after the scene shows them), shows the words with the sum under them, an observer's look as "<rank name> looks in the chamber: <verb>" with no number (the verb set after the look: 'a round in it' or 'clear'), 400 lines newest first with VIEWS §8.6's filter by kind; main.js toasts a failure that is not routine and a look that finds something in their words, a shot by its hole's tone, a range fault as a tag.
52. **The plaque's figure on a card is the chance of a hole** (`shot.js plaqueOf`: `oddsOf` at DC + the edge ring's −3; `rollOdds` keeps the pass): my call between that and scoring the edge from margin 0, which would change WEAPONS §11.1's rings. By the keys it names Fire's digit ("1 HELD FIRE"); its list shows 2.5 s after an aim or a bracket's move by the keys and over the plaque itself; it hides on a cold line or under a handling step. The holes are hashed with the world's seed.
53. **The shot on the stage**: the arms' effects drawn at the positions' time (`view.js fxMs`); `look.js FLASH_MS` 70 to 100; a 9 × 5 star at the drawn muzzle drawn after the figures (`range.js`'s blast mesh, in three's transparent pass, which comes after every opaque draw); the blast's dust (`range-items.js dustPixels`) prone and kneeling; brass two pixels with a first-tick glint, a kneeling case through the kneeling port; the shake 2 px (`lead.js`; VIEWS §2.4 says 1 px: for the lead). The case a step throws is in its 'step' fact's `brass`, which the sound ticks.
54. **The HUD's words**: the weapon card at a whole number of device pixels a card pixel (`steps.js cardScale`), its words at twice the letter, a 4 × 5 "≈"; the reflex card beside the weapon card (`steps.cardonly`); NONE's words "Nothing: stay on the card" for a click or a stoppage; PAPER numbers only the newest hole and lists every shot of a string, a miss "-" (the 'range' string fact's `list`); the I card's reach is the sim's magIn time (`kitView`'s `magInS`; CONTAINERS' reachS gone); C's file shows Marksmanship and Weapon handling where a sheet is written.
55. **The voices**: `instinct/range.js know` is kept per tick and per step, not per clock (time standing still kept the clock while a step began); the stoppage's line is quiet while a drill runs; the range-fire line has no act, so T never takes the shot; the coach's string tip by how it was shot (`COACH.string.held`, `.luck`; the shots record `care` and `nat1`).
